facts.text: Has at least one credit card.
Wants to apply for a personal loan by February 2027.
Wedding is a primary goal for next year.
Travel is a primary goal for next year.

goal_candidates.quote: How do I improve my credit utilization so that I could opt for personal loan by February 2027?

sessions.summary: User asked about their credit utilization and why 30% matters, how to improve utilization to qualify for a personal loan by Feb 2027, which banks ignore credit history, and requested other people's credit details (assistant clarified only Sameer's data available); assistant also recapped 2027 goals such as paying off debt and preparing for a big expense.
User confirmed their two big goals for next year (wedding and travel), gave months for each (wedding: Feb 2027; travel: Jun 2027), and discussed saving plans and monthly saving options.
User asked for a summary of their credit history; assistant provided a snapshot including recent score trend, drivers, and account/balance details as of Sep 2026.
